poetry.name: The Distance Between Us
poetry.content: Some distances are measured not by miles, but by everything left unsaid.

poetry.name: After the Last Light
poetry.content: The evening disappears, yet something in the fading light refuses to end.

poetry.name: The Window
poetry.content: I watched the rain cross the glass and changed nothing.

poetry.name: A Small Revolution
poetry.content: The moon forgot its lines, so the night invented another ending.

poetry.name: Skin Remembers
poetry.content: My hands remember places my mind has already forgotten.

poetry.name: What Remains Unanswered
poetry.content: If the answer changes the question, what were we asking?

poetry.name: Against the Wall
poetry.content: I speak because silence has mistaken itself for victory.

poetry.name: Tomorrow Will Hear Us
poetry.content: What we build today will become the language of tomorrow.

poetry.name: The Story We Chose
poetry.content: I entered the story halfway through and decided where it should go.

poetry.name: Come Back Slowly
poetry.content: Come back slowly; I want enough time to recognize the shape of you.

poetry.name: Before There Was a Clock
poetry.content: There was a moment before time named itself, and we were already there.

poetry.name: At the Bus Stop
poetry.content: People arrived, people left, and I simply watched the road continue.

poetry.name: The Wrong Shoes
poetry.content: I wore two different shoes and called it fashion until someone believed me.

poetry.name: Pulse
poetry.content: The body speaks first; thought arrives later, carrying its explanation.

poetry.name: Why Must We Leave?
poetry.content: Why do we call departure necessary when staying was never truly impossible?

poetry.name: No Permission
poetry.content: I stopped asking the door whether I was allowed to enter.

poetry.name: The Coming Season
poetry.content: A new season waits beyond the fear that tells us nothing will change.

poetry.name: A House With Seven Doors
poetry.content: Every door opened into another version of the same unfinished story.

poetry.name: Your Empty Chair
poetry.content: The chair remains where you left it, as though absence needs furniture.

poetry.name: No Beginning
poetry.content: Some things do not begin; they simply become visible.

poetry.name: Rain on the Field
poetry.content: The field received the rain without complaint or celebration.

poetry.name: The Moon Is Late
poetry.content: The moon arrived late and blamed traffic in the clouds.

poetry.name: Gravity
poetry.content: My feet know the earth before my mind remembers its name.

poetry.name: Who Are We Becoming?
poetry.content: Who are we becoming when every answer makes another question necessary?

poetry.name: Break the Silence
poetry.content: Let the silence break before it convinces us that it was ever sacred.

poetry.name: The First Morning
poetry.content: One morning the world will wake expecting us to have changed it.

poetry.name: The Man Who Returned
poetry.content: He returned to the same street carrying a story that no longer belonged there.

poetry.name: Almost Home
poetry.content: I have crossed every road except the one that brings me back to you.

poetry.name: Outside Time
poetry.content: The stars do not remember yesterday, yet somehow they remember us.

poetry.name: The Last Witness
poetry.content: I saw what happened and carried the memory without changing the truth.

poetry.name: The Death Is Me and Me Is Death
poetry.content: the death is me and me is death

poetry.name: How How I Be Be
poetry.content: how how i be be

poetry.name: Let's Be Mad
poetry.content: lets be mad
